name: Artist Card
summary: Passive artist summary with optional portrait, canonical Badge, and target-formatted metadata.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive artist summary by default; a target may use one native link or button root only when it owns a coherent activation boundary.

anatomy.name: portraitImage
anatomy.description: Optional portrait image whose source, intrinsic dimensions, loading, crop and alternative-text purpose are target-owned.

anatomy.name: badge
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Badge composition over an existing portrait; rendered with both .badge and .artist-card__badge.

anatomy.name: medium
anatomy.description: Optional artist medium or practice; omit the element when empty.

anatomy.name: location
anatomy.description: Optional artist location; omit the element when empty.

anatomy.name: pieceCount
anatomy.description: Optional target-localized piece count; omit the element when empty.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Card width follows its containing layout.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive default with no interaction affordance.

states.name: interactiveHover
states.description: Optional fine-pointer portrait emphasis only when a target supplies one enabled native interactive root.

states.name: interactiveFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus only on a target-supplied native interactive root.

states.name: interactiveDisabled
states.description: Optional native button root preserves native disabled semantics, leaves the sequential focus order, suppresses portrait emphasis, and shows an unavailable cursor.

behavior.name: passiveDefault
behavior.description: The shared component is passive and does not add tabindex, click handling, keyboard handling, listeners, state, or hover affordance.

behavior.name: nativeInteractionBoundary
behavior.description: A target that adds one coherent activation must use a native link or button root with an accessible name, visible focus, and no nested interactive descendants.

behavior.name: optionalContent
behavior.description: Optional parts are omitted when absent; Badge is valid only inside a present portrait and piece-count grammar remains target-owned.

behavior.name: mediaOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own portrait source, intrinsic size, responsive candidates, crop/focal data, loading priority, and informative-versus-decorative alternative text.

properties.name: portrait
properties.description: Target-owned portrait media with source, intrinsic dimensions, loading and alternative text appropriate to its context.

properties.name: badge
properties.description: Optional short canonical Badge label shown only when portrait is present.

properties.name: medium
properties.description: Optional artist medium or practice; omitted when empty.

properties.name: location
properties.description: Optional human-readable location; omitted when empty.

properties.name: pieceCount
properties.description: Optional target-localized piece-count string; omitted when empty.

accessibility: Choose portrait alternative text from its purpose: describe informative portraits concisely and use empty alternative text when the image is decorative or redundant with the adjacent artist name.
Keep the shared root passive. When a target makes the whole card interactive, use one native link or button root instead of click handling or tabindex on a passive container.
Ensure an interactive card has a descriptive accessible name, visible focus, and no nested interactive controls.
Choose the artist-name heading level from the containing document outline, omit empty optional elements, and do not rely on portrait hover motion to communicate identity or availability.

web.notes: Passive CSS-only composition with canonical Badge and conditional native-root interaction hooks in components/css/storytelling.css.

shopify.notes: Generated CSS and canonical Badge class are available; dedicated Liquid, artist data, destination, responsive portrait markup and merchant schema await target decisions. No component JavaScript is required by the neutral contract.
